hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_STDOUT" | grep -qiE '(connection refused|dial tcp)'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"No devicedeck server responded. Start it first: run `devicedeck serve` in a terminal, then retry."}'; elif echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_STDOUT" | grep -qiE '(device busy|another client is driving)'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"That device is already being driven by another tab or test run. Close it, or pick another device with list_devices."}'; elif echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_STDOUT" | grep -qiE '(driver crashed on startup)'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"The Android driver crashed on startup (a known transient dexopt race). Retry the launch; devicedeck retries the driver start itself."}'; fi
